(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing; const until=async(fn,ms)=>{ const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<ms){ if(fn()) return true; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); } return false; }; __rhf.press('primary'); if(!await until(()=>f.state==='meter',60000)) return 'no meter: '+f.state; const um=f.updateMeter.bind(f); window.__unfreeze=()=>{ f.updateMeter=um; }; f.updateMeter=(dt,tap)=>um(0,tap); const hb=f.aim.hotBand, wb=f.aim.waterBands.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.p1-b.p0)-(a.p1-a.p0))[0]; const pw=hb?(hb.p0+hb.p1)/2:(wb.p0+wb.p1)/2; f.meter.t=1.15*Math.pow(pw,1/1.3); await until(()=>Math.abs(f.meter.needle-pw)<1e-6,60000); __rhf.press('primary'); await until(()=>f.meter.phase===1,60000); f.meter.t=0.46/f.timing.speed; await until(()=>Math.abs(f.meter.cursor-0.46)<1e-6,60000); return 'timing bar held with the marker at '+f.meter.cursor.toFixed(2)+', power '+pw.toFixed(2)+(hb?' on the hotspot':' in open water'); })()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const W=g.world; const c=g.calving; const L=c.level; const clear=(x,z)=>{ const dx=c.center.x-x, dz=c.center.z-z, l=Math.hypot(dx,dz); for(const t of g.colliders.circlesNear(x,z,12)){ const tx=t.x-x, tz=t.z-z, tl=Math.hypot(tx,tz)||1; if(tl<1.5||(tx*dx+tz*dz)/(tl*l)>0.45) return false; } return true; }; let best=null; for(const strict of [true,false]){ for(let r=70;r<=(strict?200:140)&&!best;r+=10){ for(let a=0;a<64;a++){ const ang=a/64*Math.PI*2; if(Math.cos(ang)<0.2) continue; const x=c.center.x+c.dir.x*r*Math.cos(ang)+c.side.x*r*Math.sin(ang); const z=c.center.z+c.dir.z*r*Math.cos(ang)+c.side.z*r*Math.sin(ang); const h=W.heightAt(x,z); const w=W.waterAt(x,z); if(strict?(w&&w.depth>0.12&&w.depth<0.35&&clear(x,z)):(h>L+0.6&&h<L+8&&!w)){ best={x,z,strict}; break; } } } if(best) break; } if(!best) return 'no vantage'; g.player.place(best.x,best.z,0); g.env.setTime(12.5); g.player.yaw=Math.atan2(-(c.center.x-best.x),-(c.center.z-best.z)); g.player.pitch=0.12; c.timer=999; return 'glacier'+(best.strict?', wading in the shallows':', from the bank')})()
